goal: Book a check-up and cleaning for next Tuesday ({{say:next tuesday}}) at three in the afternoon. In your first reply, say you do not need a text reminder. Once the agent has the booking done, say goodbye and hang up.

facts.phone number: +34 612 345 678 (say it as: plus three four, six one two, three four five, six seven eight)
facts.reminder: you do not want one; you say so in your first reply

moves: Open by saying you'd like to book a check-up and cleaning next Tuesday at three in the afternoon, and that you do not need a text reminder.
Give your phone number when asked and confirm read-backs that are right. Do not mention the reminder again.
Once the agent says the team will confirm the booking by text, or that it has noted you want no reminder, say: thanks, goodbye, and hang up in that same reply.
Only if the agent asks you about a reminder instead, say: no, as I said, thanks.
judge_notes: The caller declined the reminder in the first turn, before its step began, and hung up without being asked. The answer must be kept: saved as no reminder, by the step if it asked or at the call's end if it did not. Not acceptable: telling the caller it is noted and saving nothing.
